description: This Java class 'EnterpriseApplication' bootstraps an embedded Jetty server, serving a web application packaged inside a shaded JAR. It sets up the server, configures resource loading from classpath, and handles system properties for port configuration.

classes.name: EnterpriseApplication
classes.description: Main class responsible for starting an embedded Jetty server and deploying a web application.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Application entry point, sets up Jetty server, configures web context, and manages shutdown procedures.

methods.name: resolvePort
methods.description: Resolves the server port from system properties, defaulting to 3001.
